format: SharkPort save ("SharkPortSave", kind 0x000F0000): title "POKEMON SAPP", date "Save21/04/2004 19:17:00 41", notes ""; cart header "POKEMON SAPP" / 'AXPE' (complement 0x54); payload 65536 bytes; checksum: unsigned
